notes: Difficulty comes from the multi-stage deliverable (declare correct PEP 517 metadata + entry point, implement an exact fractional-currency parser with rounding and validation, build an offline wheel) chained end-to-end, plus a 34-case hidden suite of edge and malformed inputs that probes generalization from the README contract. Quantitative correctness (exact cent arithmetic, half-away-from-zero rounding, sign/currency handling) and hidden-case generalization drive the medium bucket; no network/state/resource pressure.
